0.desc: Diamond Bar Wet Badder is a sharp, sativa-leaning hybrid concentrate that brings electric flavor and record-breaking potency. Bred by crossing Diamond Dust with a select Fig Bar Male (GSE 55), this in-house creation sets a new bar—literally. The first lab test shattered expectations, clocking in at an impressive 4.4% total terpenes, delivering a powerhouse sensory experience. Packed into a 1g jar of rich, velvety badder, Diamond Bar hits with a refreshing burst of Lime Gatorade-like citrus, followed by a bright, energetic lift that’s perfect for daytime sessions. This concentrate is for those who want bold flavor, top-tier terpene content, and a buzz that cuts through the noise.

1.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation. The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. The result is an immersive, gourmet experience that dances between tangy citrus, spicy earthiness, and delicate floral sweetness. As the high unfolds, Max AC sets the stage for a state of inspired focus and tranquil contentment. The initial rush sparks an elevated mood, fueling creative thoughts and a sense of invigorated drive ideal for sketching out new ideas or engaging in reflective planning. Gradually, a soothing calm pervades the body, nurturing a feeling of quiet satisfaction and mental clarity. Max AC's dynamic progression from an energizing lift to a serene, grounding calm invites you to embrace an active, yet reflective state, transforming your day into an exploration of both creative vibrancy and peaceful repose.Strain Type: Hybrid Lineage: [Mac 1] x [Animal Cookies] Breeder: Greenpoint Genetics Primary Terpene Profile: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, Bisabolol Top Reported Strain Effects: Calm, Contented, Motivated, Uplifted, Peaceful Top Reported Strain Flavors: Citrus, Creamy, Spicy, Earthy, Herbal, Floral The Product: Uncured fresh frozen plant material created into a frosting/peanut-butter like substance that is high in terpene content allowing maximum flavor and effect. This consistency is easy to handle and on par with live budder for potency.

2.desc:
Kandy Cake is a cured resin badder crafted from Bass River Buds’ organically grown, no-till living soil flower, bringing together the rich genetic pairing of Kut Throat Kandy x Ice Cream Cake in a terpene-forward concentrate format. Carefully dried, cured, and extracted to preserve the cultivar’s natural complexity, this batch delivers a dense, creamy profile layered with candy sweetness, vanilla frosting, earthy gas, and subtle citrus brightness. Floral undertones and soft spice from its dominant terpene blend round out the finish with classic cured resin depth and full-bodied character.

Led by high levels of ß-Caryophyllene alongside Limonene, ß-Myrcene, and Linalool, Kandy Cake offers a balanced aromatic profile that moves between sweet dessert richness and savory fuel notes without losing the cultivar’s natural expression. The badder consistency provides a smooth, workable texture ideal for flavorful concentrate sessions while staying true to the source flower.

Produced as part of the Eclipse x Bass River Buds collaboration, this cured resin badder is made from 100% cannabis with nothing added — preserving the integrity of the flower, the extraction, and the cultivar-driven terpene profile from start to finish.

3.desc:
Triple Gas is a cured resin badder crafted from Bass River Buds’ organically grown, no-till living soil flower. A bold blend of Donny Burger, Animal Face, and Platinum Dolato, this concentrate preserves the cultivar’s naturally heavy, savory, and fuel-forward profile through a careful cured resin extraction process.

The flavor opens with pungent diesel, earthy funk, and peppery spice before rounding into bright citrus, subtle floral notes, and a smooth doughy sweetness on the finish. Driven by dominant levels of ß-Caryophyllene, Limonene, and a-Humulene, Triple Gas delivers layered gassy depth with rich cured resin character and a balanced terpene-forward profile.

Carefully dried, cured, and extracted to retain the integrity of the source flower, this badder features a soft, workable consistency ideal for consumers seeking a flavorful and strain-specific dabbable concentrate experience.

Made with 100% cannabis and nothing added, Eclipse x Bass River Buds Triple Gas Cured Resin Badder reflects clean extraction, quality cultivation, and concentrate craftsmanship rooted in the natural expression of the flower.

Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects.  Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers. 

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

The Black Maple strain is a unique hybrid strain that combines the genetic traits of the Dulce De Uva and Sherbanger strains. As a hybrid variety, it has inherited qualities from both its parent strains, resulting in a unique genetic makeup that gives it distinct features, effects, and characteristics.

Dulce De Uva, a cross of Grape Pie and OG Kush, is cherished for its sweet, grape-like scent and deeply relaxing stone. Sherbanger, the other parent of Black Maple, is known for its rich, creamy flavor and dense, frosty buds. By combining the two, Bloom Seeds has created a stellar hybrid that embodies all the qualities of an elite strain.

The flavor of this strain is just as delightful, coating the mouth with the sweet flavors of blueberry ice cream and exotic spices. The taste lingers for several minutes, making for a pleasant experience that any cannabis user is sure to love.

This unique blend combines the soothing qualities of an indica with the uplifting effects of a sativa, offering a gentle yet powerful experience that calms the body and elevates the spirit. With its harmonious nature, Animal Star Cookies helps users relax and find themselves in a state of emotional well-being.
The strain's rich terpene profile contributes to its complex flavors and effects. Sweet and earthy notes are complemented by hints of vanilla and nutty undertones, creating a delightful and nuanced taste experience. The presence of Limonene adds a subtle citrus zest, while Linalool imparts gentle floral accents. These terpenes enhance not only the flavor but also promote a calming and uplifting mood.
Drawing from its parent genetics, Animal Star Cookies inherits the full-body relaxation characteristic of Animal Cookies and the mood-enhancing properties of Stardawg. Users often report feelings of tranquility and happiness, with a gentle elevation of mood that eases away stress and encourages a positive mindset. This balanced hybrid is ideal for those seeking to unwind while maintaining a sense of alertness and emotional well-being.

Astronaut Status 24 (Hybrid) Zero Gravity x Mai Tai #4

One small puff for you, one giant couch-lock for mankind. Born from the cosmic collision of Zero Gravity and Mai Tai #4, this intergalactic hybrid delivers a gassy, fruity funk so loud it needs its own helmet. With deep purple buds and a terp profile that smacks of tropical fruit, diesel, earth, it’s like
your taste buds just went through a wormhole. The effects? Euphoric, stoney, and floaty enough to have you orbiting your living room like it’s mission control. Whether you're watching the stars or becoming one with the couch, Astronaut Status #24 will take you there, no training required.

170.desc: Spreadsheet Cake is a hybrid with dense, frosty green and purple buds, blending sweet vanilla cake, berry, and creamy pastry flavors with subtle citrus and earthy diesel notes. Its aroma is irresistibly sweet and fruity, and effects include euphoric relaxation, hazy creativity, and gentle sedation—making it perfect for unwinding, sparking inspiration, or late-night indulgence.

171.desc: Pink Mochi delivers a decadent mix of creamy vanilla and candy-like fruit flavors, offering a complex and memorable profile. This hybrid balances sweet dessert-like notes with smooth, easygoing vibes, making it a flavorful choice for any session.

172.desc:

This new Skunk Master Flex hybrid strain is the perfect blend of creamy banana funk and pungent, fruity floral aromas – like dipping banana bread in sweet cream. Sit back and enjoy the mellow body and mind high with euphoric, relaxing and slightly talkative effects – perfect for daytime and evening consumption.

174.desc: True to its name, Game Over comes through with heavy-hitting flavor and presence. This strain brings forward deep, gassy notes layered with earthy spice and a touch of sweet funk, creating a rich and unforgettable profile. Potent and full-bodied, it’s a knockout choice for those who like their smoke strong and flavorful.

175.desc: Embark on a journey with Riptide Rush, a captivating hybrid strain born from the union of Grape Crashers and Pie Eyed. With a genetic lineage that promises a unique combination of qualities, Riptide Rush offers a multifaceted experience. Delight in its uplifting and relaxed effects that unfold into a cerebral and social euphoria, leaving users feeling giggly and at ease. The strain's aromatic profile is a harmonious blend of earthy undertones, sweet berry notes, and a hint of citrus. Immerse yourself in the world of Riptide Rush and explore the synergy of its lineage, effects, and delightful aroma.

176.desc:
Blissful Wizard #32 x Blissful Wizard

-------------

Breakwater Small Batch is a series of limited releases created to bring you closer to our strain selection process. This project gives you the opportunity to explore strains that are still being evaluated for large scale production. Some of these strains may even return to our menu.

-------------

Blissful Wizard Bx1 originates from the renowned Maine breeder, the Captain’s Connection, also known as CookieMaine. Celebrated for his love of cookie varieties, CookieMaine burst into prominence with his original Blissful Wizard cross. The lore of this variety became so legendary that he sought to stabilize it into a seed line. Blissful Wizard Bx1 is a backcross of a standout male and a potent phenotype (#32), selected by CookieMaine during a pheno hunt of the original Blissful Wizard.

Showcasing classic Cookie genetics, Blissful Wizard Bx1 develops with beautiful structure, abundant branches, and dense, bulbous flowers. While live plants exude a dank GMO funkyness that parallels our Blue & Cream, the cured flower delivers a complex, layered bouquet of peppery kush and subtle creaminess. This phenotype may lean sedative, inducing heavy eyelids and body relaxation.

177.desc:
(Headband x ChemD) x Skunkdog Bx1

Cerebral. Invigorating. Euphoric. All words that describe (Headband x ChemD) x Skunkdog Bx1. This standout from Matchmaker Genetics brings together two legendary cultivars of prohibition-era cannabis with a proven male stud used in over thirty outcrosses by the breeder.

Our selected phenotype grows with moderate vigor and a healthy spread of branches that bloom conical, Christmas tree-shaped flowers. Expect a slightly sour, diesel fuel-tinged aroma up front from the Headband lineage, followed by a heavy-hitting chemical cleaner and fuel finish – classic ChemD.

The Hawaiian-bred Skunkdog Bx1, a staple strain on the islands, is known for its ability to withstand high humidity and thrive in even the wettest climates. This powerhouse male amplifies the acrid funk of Headband and ChemD and adds hardiness to the cross. While the flowering time runs longer than average, the payoff is worth the wait – a potent, complex expression of sour, skunk, and chem exploding from every bud.

-------------

178.desc:
Ice Cream Nana x Strawberry Runtz

-------------

This strain is part of Breakwater's Pheno Hunt project. Short for “Phenotype Hunt,” a Pheno Hunt is the search for the best possible version of a strain. When we acquire seeds of a compelling strain, we grow multiple plants to maturity. Each plant is a unique physical expression or phenotype of its genetic makeup (just like children from the same parents can be quite different). We evaluate each phenotype for traits such as flower size, plant structure, aromas, effects, and potency. In a successful Pheno Hunt, the most promising candidate will become a mother plant for a new strain of Breakwater Premium Flower.

With this new patient-facing project, we're inviting you to participate in this process and give us your feedback on which pheno is the best fit for our patients!

-------------

Phenotype #46 of Ice Cream Bananaz is closely aligned to the paternal lineage of the cross and, more specifically, to its grandfather, Runtz. Commonly known in cannabis forums as the improved Gelato, Runtz is beloved for its sweet, juicy aromas and nostalgic fruit candy flavors. Looking and tasting like sugar-frosted candy, #46’s buds check all the right Runtz boxes and may provide an uplifting and euphoric experience to match.

179.desc: Bold, skunky, and deeply soothing—Animal Ice is a hybrid that doesn’t hold back. With earthy undertones and a cool, frosty finish, this strain delivers full-body calm with a hint of wild. Designed for those who appreciate a heavier unwind, Animal Ice melts tension and quiets the mind while keeping the flavor rich and rugged.

180.desc: Generally referred to as Alien Dawg (“Ether” cut), this is one of the more sought after phenotypes of the indica-dominant hybrid Alien Dawg and has been used to create other hybrids such as Alien Abduction and Lemon Alien Dawg. Leaning more towards the Chemdawg 91 side of its heritage, Ether is known for its intense sour smell and amazing trichome production.

181.desc:
Miracle Mints is a smooth, well-balanced hybrid with refreshing minty notes and subtle sweetness. It wraps you in full-body comfort and gentle tingles without clouding your
mind, leaving you clear-headed and relaxed. Ideal for unwinding after a long day, movie nights, or simply enjoying a moment of calm.

Kush Mints x Alien Cookies

182.desc:
Introducing the Turtle Pie Co Sidewalk Sunday Strain, a unique and potent Indica-dominant hybrid that offers a well-balanced high with effects that hit both mind and body.

This turtle pie strain is crafted by the esteemed Turtle Pie Co in the Bay Area and is known for its distinctive terpene profile and reported effects.

Coming in at around 30% THC this ‘gelato 41’ x ‘happy accident’ cross is something of a must-try. Smokes beautifully but even before you break it down the nose pops the second you open the jar.

The crystals on all of the buds and the residue they leave on your fingers show you that this is the za.

183.desc: Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher ------------- Breakwater Small Batch is a series of limited releases created to bring you closer to our strain selection process. This project gives you the opportunity to explore strains that are still being evaluated for large scale production. Some of these strains may even return to our menu. ------------- Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different. Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole. Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

184.desc: Military Chocolate is a potent, balanced 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain bred by Oni Seed Co (Bubba Kush x Tropicanna Cookies). It is known for its rich, dessert-like aroma of chocolate, coffee, and creamy vanilla. The high offers a fast-acting, euphoric, and creative buzz, accompanied by, relaxing body effects suitable for treating stress.

RYTHM Premium Flower delivers a consistently elevated cannabis experience from the #1 Flower Brand in the World¹. 188.desc: The Cookies and Cream flavor is very much like the name suggests, with tastes of sweet vanilla and nutty earth topped with creamy butter. The aroma is just as delicious, with an overtone of sweet nutty earth and a touch of vanilla as the nugs are burned. The Cookies and Cream high has sweet long-lasting effects that are perfect for any hybrid lover. The high starts with a happy head lift that's both euphoric and creative with a slight sense of energy. This is accompanied by a relaxing sleepy effect that leaves you dazed and blissfully unaware of any pain or anything happening around you.

189.desc: The Strain: Cherry AK springs from the famed AK-47 lineage, with whispers of a cherry-skunk phenotype from Skunk #1 weaving in layers of intrigue. On the palate, limonene delivers a bright cherry-candy burst, while caryophyllene adds a spicy undercurrent that rounds out into earthy, diesel-tinged depth. Myrcene’s musky warmth and pinene’s crisp pine notes anchor the profile, and ocimene sneaks in subtle floral sweetness, each draw a reminder of why Cherry AK stands out in any lineup. When it lands, Cherry AK’s sativa spark ignites an uplifted mood and a rush of creative energy. Limonene’s mood-boosting qualities pair with pinene’s focus-enhancing clarity to keep ideas flowing, while caryophyllene tempers the mind with a gentle sense of calm. As the ride continues, myrcene’s mellowing effects lend a light-body ease that keeps you grounded without slowing you down. From daytime brainstorming sessions to spirited social hangs, Cherry AK invites you to explore and connect. Its vivid cherry aroma and lively cerebral lift make it a go-to for carving out memorable moments, no couch required. Strain Type: Sativa Lineage: Unknown (Suspected [AK 47] x [Phenotype from Skunk 1] Breeder: Original Breeder Unknown (AK 47 Originally Bred by Serious Seeds) Primary Terpenes: Myrcene, Caryophyllene, Limonene, Pinene, Ocimene Top Reported Strain Effects: Uplifted, Creative, Talkative, Relaxed, Motivated Top Reported Strain Flavors: Cherry, Earthy, Diesel, Pepper, Pine, Fruit

190.desc: OG Kush x Miracle Animal Cookies by DNA Genetics.

191.desc: Local Skunk is a hybrid strain that is perfect for any fan of potent skunk strains. The Local Skunk high will hit you quickly, beginning with a happy boost that lifts the spirits and locks your mind into a place of heady euphoria. A buzzy body high comes next, slowly sinking into your entire physical form before locking you down entirely to the couch. A sharp pang of hunger wraps things up, so make sure you have some snacks nearby to quell your munchies.

192.desc:
Profile & Experience

Appearance: Features a "Big Buds" selection, ensuring you receive chunky, well-formed premium nugs rather than small popcorn buds.

Flavor Note: A distinct blend of sweet, deep fruit undertones layered with a sharp, savory, or slightly sour profile.

Effects: Best suited for experienced consumers looking for a potent punch. It delivers a strong, full-body physical relaxation coupled with a heavy, calming mental state that is excellent for evening use or easing into a peaceful sleep.

194.desc:
Pete's Farmstand Toll Money Smalls (7g) is a popular hybrid cannabis flower in New Jersey. Known for its sweet, citrusy, and peppery flavor profile.

Flavor & Aroma:

Sweet, earthy, and slightly citrusy, Toll Money teases the senses with a rich, complex aroma that lingers with every inhale.

Effects:

Enjoy a harmonious hybrid high: a gentle mental uplift paired with calming body relaxation, ideal for creative endeavors, social sessions, or winding down after a busy day.

Perfect For: Anytime you want the best of both worlds—a hybrid high that energizes your mind while soothing your body.

195.desc:
Yoshi from Pete’s Farmstand is best thought of as a bright, modern hybrid with a playful profile. Based on how Pete’s Farmstand menus and related strain descriptions are typically presented, it likely leans toward sweet, fruity, and candy-like notes rather than the heavy gas of a classic OG, with a flavor that feels more lively than earthy.

The experience is usually described as balanced at first, with a quick cerebral lift that can make things feel more upbeat, chatty, and visually sharp before easing into a gentler body calm. That makes it a strain many people associate with afternoon or early evening use, especially when they want something enjoyable without immediately getting knocked out.

If you like strains that feel modern, flavorful, and easy to enjoy, Yoshi fits that lane well. It sounds like one of Pete’s Farmstand’s more approachable options: less pine-and-diesel, more sweet smoke, smooth vibes, and a steady hybrid finish.

196.desc:
Type: Hybrid

Lineage: LCG x Runtz

Breeder: Seed Junky Genetics

Taste Notes: Sweet berries, citrus zest, with a creamy earthy diesel undertone.

Super Runtz is a hybrid from Seed Junky Genetics that brings LCG and Runtz genetics together. Sweet berries and citrus zest open the profile before settling into creamy earthy diesel undertones. With a terpene profile that balances fruit-forward brightness with fuel complexity, this cultivar demonstrates sophisticated aromatic layering.

The LCG lineage contributes creamy diesel foundation and structural depth, while Runtz introduces its signature berry sweetness and citrus brightness. Effects tend to begin with gentle mental ease before transitioning into substantial body relaxation, creating an experience that maintains clarity while delivering indica weight.

This cultivar speaks to those seeking refined candy genetics with genuine complexity—sweet fruit expression grounded by traditional diesel character for evening use that satisfies both flavor and effect expectations.

197.desc:
This drop is bigger than just flower. It’s about legacy, culture, and respect.

White Boy Kev is a Washington Heights legend. Back in the early 90’s, when the city was in the grip of the crack epidemic, Kev chose a different lane. He carved out his own path with weed because he never saw it as a drug – to him it was medicine, community, and love for the block. It was a way to uplift, not harm. Running three spots in the Heights, Kev built his name the real way: he gave the community something authentic, something that healed.

Fast-forward 35 years, and Kev's still in it for the plant – not just as a hustler, but as a grower. His pursuit now is mastery: learning, evolving, and working with cultivators who share his dedication to quality. That's why teaming up with niche. made sense – Jersey and Washington Heights are just a river apart, and this collaboration bridges that gap.

Irish Springz celebrates a genuine legend in the game. This is legacy work – paying homage to the ones who paved the way while pushing the culture forward.

----

Irish Springz is a hybrid that delivers a clean, nostalgic flavor experience—sweet notes that flow into delicate floral characteristics before finishing with that distinctive soapy dryer sheet aroma that gives this strain its name.

Effects might offer that balanced flow between mental clarity and physical relaxation. Many people appreciate how this one can work for different parts of the day, though everyone's experience varies. With 34.53% Total THC and a terpene profile led by ß-Caryophyllene and d-Limonene, this strain brings both potency and complexity to the table.

This hybrid connects with those who want flavors that tell a story and effects that keep things real. It's got that old-school authenticity with modern craft appeal—a strain that represents legacy, culture, and the bridge between street wisdom and cultivation mastery for those looking to experience something with genuine roots.

199.desc: Lineage: Black Cherry Punch x Tropicana Cookies

200.desc: Magic Marker is a 50/50 hybrid that hits the nose with a sharp burst of sweet candy, citrus zest, and tropical fruit, layered over a backend of chemical funk and creamy gas. There’s a slightly “inky” or artificial sweetness to it – that gives it a unique, almost nostalgic marker-like terp twist. On the inhale, expect sugary sherbet and fruit; on the exhale, a lingering gassy, slightly piney after tone.

201.desc: Flash Point OG is a hybrid cannabis strain known for its relaxing, euphoric, and calming effects. It is noted for its distinctive citrus, spicy, and floral aroma. The specific genetics for this strain are not widely publicized, but its lineage is different from that of other OG strains.

202.desc:
Gillie's Galaxy Zaarie Irving is a highly potent hybrid cannabis strain. It is characterized by its heavy terpene profile.

Dominant Terpenes: Beta Myrcene (promoting a relaxed state), Alpha Pinene (energizing), and Beta Caryophyllene (anti-inflammatory).

Effects: Because it's a balanced hybrid, users report a fusion of mental alertness and physical relaxation.

203.desc:
Jersey Runtz from Garden Greens is a sweet, candy-like hybrid with the kind of bold flavor profile that has made Runtz family strains so popular. It usually brings fruity, tropical notes up front, followed by creamy undertones and a light earthy or gassy finish that adds depth to the experience.

The flower is typically dense, frosty, and visually striking, with bright green buds, purple accents, and vivid orange hairs. That polished look gives it strong bag appeal and makes it feel like a premium craft selection.

In terms of effects, Jersey Runtz is often described as balanced and enjoyable, starting with an upbeat, happy headspace before easing into a calm, relaxed body feel. It can be a good choice for people who want something flavorful and smooth without feeling overly heavy too soon.

Overall, Garden Greens’ Jersey Runtz delivers a well-rounded mix of sweetness, aroma, and relaxation. It’s the kind of strain that appeals to consumers who like dessert-style cannabis with a lively, approachable finish.

204.desc: Fresh Specimen X is a potent, evenly balanced hybrid strain created by crossing Project 4516 and Devil Driver. It is highly regarded for its aromatic profile—boasting gassy, creamy notes mixed with exotic fruit—and is known to deliver a creeping, full-body calm without heavy couchlock.

205.desc:
Picture a tropical candy shop tucked into a coastal sunset Pineapple Belts is a true hybrid that opens with bright, juicy pineapple, followed by a smooth, candy finish, that lingers just long enough to keep you coming back!

The effects strike a clean balance. An uplifting; feel good headspace paired with a calm, steady body feel. You stay present, social, and clear minded while the tension melts away. It's the kind of hybrid that works any time of day, whether you're creating, hanging out, or easing into the evening without slowing all the way down.

206.desc: A popular hybrid cannabis strain, a cross of Biscotti and Sherb Cream Pie, known for its indulgent dessert-like aroma and flavor, featuring sweet, creamy, and citrus notes with hints of gas and fruit, delivering a balanced euphoric and relaxing body high, making it great for stress relief, mood boosting, and unwinding.

207.desc:
Lineage & Flavor: Bred with elite mint genetics, you can expect a sharp, crisp mint aroma blended with rich earthy, herbal, and sweet cookie-esque undertones.

Effects: Typically leans toward a deeply physically relaxing hybrid effect, ideal for winding down, easing tension, and easing into a calm state of mind.

208.desc:
Aroma & Flavor: Sweet tropical fruit, berries, and sugar candy on the inhale with a sharp, gassy exhale and earthy herbal finish.

Effects: Euphoric, social cerebral lift paired with a smooth, mellow body relaxation.

Dominant Terpenes: Beta-myrcene and beta-caryophyllene.

209.desc: Candy Fumes is a hybrid created from the indica-forward Zkittlez and the high-potency Sherbanger. Candy Fumes packs the same sweet and flavorful palette as Zkittlez while incorporating the benefits of Sherbanger's superior genetics. That means a strong terpene profile and THC levels that typically exceed both of its parent strains, winning fans as much for its craveable flavor profile as for its warm body high. Fruity and sweet on the nose, fans of Candy Fumes report a giddy front end and gentle comedown for easy relaxation and pain relief.

Patients report that Banana Puddintain leaves them feeling creative, euphoric and cheerful.

211.desc: Lime, Mixed fruit salad, original candy Z terps with hints of OG Gas.

212.desc:
Flavor and Aroma Profile

This strain features a sweet, dessert-like profile. You can expect deep notes of ripe blackberries combined with a rich, baked-goods cake finish and subtle hints of earthy undertones.

213.desc:
Pungent gas and lemon peel with a classic, heady profile known for its signature pressure-like effect. A staple strain that continues to resonate with experienced consumers.

Lineage: Sour Diesel × OG Kush

214.desc: Light, floral, and citrus-forward with a smooth, easygoing character. Clean and approachable with a refined terpene profile.

215.desc: Candy Pop is a Gastro Pop phenotype created by crossing Grape Gasoline with Apples & Bananas. This hybrid strain has a potent fruity, sweet, and spicy aroma. Expect an arousing yet calming effect.

216.desc: CannaBama Relief provides an easygoing hybrid effect with an uplifting headspace and light body relaxation, making it a great choice for daytime sessions or casual social moments.

217.desc:
Strain Overview

Lineage: Bred by Raw Genetics, Zikigai is typically a cross of Rainbow Belts 2.0 x Original Z.

Aroma & Flavor: Known for a loud, "Z-on-steroids" aroma. It features a sharp, candy-forward profile resembling Fruity Pebbles and sugary Zkittlez mixed with heavy gas.

Appearance: The "Red" phenotype is celebrated for its vibrant crimson and red hues mixed into dense, heavily frosted trichome-covered buds.

Effects: Offers a functional, daytime, creative high. It balances a cerebral euphoric burst with soothing body relaxation without immediate sedation.

218.desc: ROSIN TECH LABS presents Oklahoma Oreoz Hash Nugs, a premium infused flower experience in a convenient 3.5g format. This hybrid delivers the best of both worlds, combining balanced effects that inspire creativity and relaxation in equal measure. Each nug is expertly infused with quality hash, elevating potency and flavor beyond traditional flower. Expect rich, earthy aromas with sweet, creamy notes reminiscent of cookies and cream, complemented by subtle diesel undertones. Perfect for experienced consumers seeking enhanced effects, this infused flower provides a smooth, flavorful smoke with long-lasting euphoria and full-body relaxation. Whether unwinding after a long day or sparking creative inspiration, Oklahoma Oreoz delivers a sophisticated cannabis experience that showcases ROSIN TECH LABS' commitment to quality craftsmanship and innovation in infused products.

219.desc:
It all starts with premium indoor Kind Tree flower, the same whole nugs that you already know and love. We carefully spray each nug with distillate oil to achieve 20% coverage and put a good base layer to adhere the THCa powder isolate. Then we apply a 15% coverage of THCa powder to give the nugs the frosty, snowy look, inspiring the name "Snowballs".

Crack one open to find a lush green nug inside.

Quench your thirst for blissful relaxation with Cherry Slushee! This tantalizing Hybrid blends the iconic Cherry AK47 with the refreshing Kushmints, creating a flavor fusion bursting with cherry sweetness, zesty lime, and a hint of spicy kick. Dive into a wave of calming serenity that energizes the senses, making Cherry Slushee your perfect pick for unwinding after a long day or boosting creativity during a laid-back afternoon brainstorm session.

220.desc: Sour Apricot is a fast-acting, hybrid famous for its "one-hit-quit" potency. It delivers an uplifting cerebral rush followed by deep, giggly physical relaxation. It is highly sought-after for easing stress, depression, and minor pain.

221.desc:
Blue Nerdz is a hybrid from Global Genetics LA that brings Lemon Cherry Gelato and Zkittles genetics together. This strain delivers a nostalgic flavor profile—sweet candy notes that dominate the palate with slight gassy undertones keeping it grounded.

Effects might offer that playful balance between mental energy and body ease. Many people appreciate how this one brings back those carefree vibes while still delivering quality effects, though it hits everyone different. The Lemon Cherry Gelato genetics contribute that dessert-like smoothness, while Zkittles adds its signature fruity candy twist to the mix.

This hybrid connects with those who want flavors that bring out their inner kid and effects that keep things fun but satisfying. It's like candy store nostalgia with some grown-up appeal—a strain that makes any session feel like a treat for those looking to add some sweetness to their rotation.

222.desc: Decadent and dense, Oakland Oreoz is your chocolate-lover’s dream. This blend of chocolate-forward and Oreoz cultivars delivers thick, creamy smoke with dessert-like sweetness and a heavy, calming high. Best enjoyed when you’re ready to sink into the couch and treat yourself right.

223.desc: Gunpowder Milkshake is a unique hybrid strain that combines bold, earthy flavors with creamy sweetness. It offers a relaxing yet uplifting experience, making it ideal for unwinding without being overly sedating. The strain’s smooth, creamy smoke with a hint of spice is perfect for those seeking a flavorful and balanced high. Tastes: Earthy, creamy, sweet, with a touch of spice Effects: Relaxing, uplifting, calming

224.desc: PK Crasher is a potent hybrid strain that results from crossing Pure Kush with Wedding Crasher. This strain boasts a complex aroma profile of spicy, peppery, and citrus notes, thanks to its dominant terpenes, caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene, and linalool. PK Crasher is known for its calming and relaxing effects that can also provide a boost of energy. This strain can help users relieve stress, anxiety, and depression, and improve their sleep quality. PK Crasher is ideal for nighttime use and can provide a peaceful and restful sleep. Lineage: Pure Kush x Wedding Crasher Top Effects: Emotional Relief, Sleep, Calming Aroma: Spicy, Pepper, Citrus Top Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene, Linalool

225.desc:
The strain was first introduced to the market amid a wave of interest in purple-colored weed strains, which had gained traction as a symbol of both beauty and high potency. Grape Rips offers an aroma that is both complex and deeply inviting, making it a delightful sensory experience even before consumption. The dominant scent profile carries unmistakable hints of sweet grapes with subtle undertones of earthy musk and berry.

At the onset, the strain is known to induce euphoria, characterized by heightened mental clarity and an elevated mood. This phase is typically marked by an immediate burst of creative energy, making it suitable for social settings and creative endeavors.

As the high deepens, users begin to experience profound physical relaxation, which is reflective of the strain’s indica heritage. Medical users have noted that this shift can be particularly beneficial for relieving muscle tension, chronic pain, and stress-related symptoms.

226.desc: The Strain: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation. The flavor profile of Max AC is a journey in complexity and depth. It opens with a bright citrus burst provided by limonene, delivering an immediate zing that awakens the senses. The spicy, peppery nuances of caryophyllene interlace with the rich, earthy foundation of myrcene and humulene, creating a multi-layered taste that is both robust and satisfying. Bisabolol rounds out the experience with subtle floral hints, adding an elegant softness that completes the symphony of flavors. From the first inhale, this strain delivers an intricate blend of sweet citrus, creamy vanilla, and earthy spice. Each draw reveals new layers of complexity, with notes of fruit and spice melting into a velvety, dessert-like finish that lingers on the palate.

Caryophyllene contributes a subtle peppery warmth that enriches the sweetness, as Linalool lends a soft floral calm. The addition of Humulene and Bisabolol rounds out the bouquet with woody and honeyed undertones, giving the strain a signature aroma that’s both uplifting and soothing.

The effects of Sunset Frost Cookies unfold like a slow sunset, beginning with a wave of euphoria that lifts the mind before easing into a serene, full-body calm. The cerebral clarity encourages mellow conversation or introspection, while the physical relaxation melts away lingering tension without sedation. Perfect for winding down the day or embracing a peaceful evening, Sunset Frost Cookies offers a luxurious balance of sweetness, depth, and calm – an indulgent hybrid that delivers on every note.

244.desc:
Brute's Roots "Blue Lobzter" 3.5g is a premium, indica-dominant hybrid cannabis flower cultivated and distributed across recreational dispensaries in New Jersey. This award-winning strain is a rare cross between Apples N Bananas and Eye Candy, originally popularized by Maine Trees and bred by Chris Lynch.

Strain Profile & Characteristics

• Lineage: Apples N Bananas x Eye Candy
• Type: Indica-Dominant Hybrid
• Potency & Terpenes: Batches from Brute's Roots typically test quite high, showing around 32.9% THC and 2.14% Terpenes.
• Appearance: Dense, resinous emerald buds featuring deep blue and purple undertones, heavily frosted in trichomes and accented by fiery orange hairs—resembling a unique "lobster shell" aesthetic.
• Aroma & Flavor: A complex "fruity gas" profile. It leads with a sweet, sugary blueberry candy and grape flavor, followed by hints of tart green apples, creamy undertones, and a smooth citrus/gassy finish.

Effects & Experience

The strain hits quickly, delivering a soaring, euphoric mental high that boosts mood and creativity. This is followed closely by a deep, calming physical relaxation that settles across the body, easing tension without immediately locking you to the couch. It is highly regarded as a great late-afternoon or evening strain for unwinding or socializing.

264.desc: Hawaiian Rain is a hybrid cannabis strain derived from London Pound Mints and Jealousy. 265.desc:
Berry Bomb: The terpene profile of this Berry Bomb may offer a deeply calming, body-centered experience that leans toward rest.

Myrcene leads the profile, with an earthy, ripe-mango aroma. It is often associated with a heavy, soothing sense of physical relaxation that could help you settle in for the evening.

ß-Caryophyllene follows with a warm, peppery spice, like black pepper. It is the one terpene known to interact with the body's cannabinoid receptors, and it may help soften physical tension and discomfort.

Linalool adds a soft, lavender-like floral note. It may quiet a busy mind and encourage a peaceful headspace that supports winding down.

Ocimene brings a sweet, herbal brightness found in orchids and basil, and it has long been valued in perfumery. It may add a gentle lift to balance the deeper notes.

a-Humulene contributes a woody, earthy depth and shares its origins with brewing hops. It may support full-body comfort, and it is also noted for its purported appetite-suppressing effect.

Rounding out the profile are limonene, the citrus-rind note that could brighten the mood; nerolidol, found in jasmine and tea tree; ß-pinene, found in rosemary and parsley; terpineol, with its lilac-like scent; fenchol, found in basil and fennel; valencene, named for the Valencia orange; a-bisabolol, also found in chamomile; and a-pinene, the scent of pine needles.

266.desc:
The terpene profile of this Unicorn strain may deliver an uplifting and giggly experience, sparking joyful mental motivation while floating over a gentle layer of physical comfort.

Dominant limonene, commonly found in citrus rinds, could elevate your mood and bring a bright wave of cheerful energy to inspire easy giggles.

Lavender-scented linalool might quiet a racing mind, encouraging a serene and peaceful headspace that keeps the playful high feeling smooth.

Spicy beta-caryophyllene from black pepper may interact with body receptors to help softly soothe physical stress and ground the energetic mood.

Woodsy alpha-humulene, sharing genetic origins with traditional brewing hops, could softly support full-body comfort as you relax into a good laugh, and may even suppress your appetite!

Grounding myrcene, abundant in sweet mangoes, might introduce a soft layer of physical ease to keep the experience wonderfully balanced.

Finally, woody beta-pinene, present in fresh rosemary and parsley, could support active mental clarity and subtle cognitive focus to keep your thoughts bright.

267.desc:
Spaceman: The terpene profile of this Spaceman strain may deliver a mostly relaxing experience, driven by a unique blend of terpenes that grounds the body in deep comfort while sparking a sweet, uplifted mental state.

Dominant beta-caryophyllene, present in black pepper, may interact with body receptors to help softly soothe physical tension and support deep bodily relaxation.

Woodsy alpha-humulene, sharing genetic origins with traditional brewing hops, might softly support full-body comfort as you unwind into ease as well as reduce appetite.

Bright limonene from citrus rinds could elevate your mood, adding a splash of refreshing mental clarity to balance the heavy physical calm.

Sweet ocimene, present in orchids and basil and historically valued in fine European perfumery for its sweet floral aroma, might offer a light spark of creative motivation.

Rarely featured prominently, sabinene hydrate is an uncommon terpene naturally found in marjoram, oak, and carrot seed oil; historically used in soothing herbal tea preparations, it may encourage a serene and grounding sense of tranquility.

Finally, citrusy valencene, named after Valencia oranges where it naturally occurs and historically used as an aromatic pest deterrent, could promote a light sense of balanced harmony.

The terpene profile of this GMO BX1 may offer a relaxed, comfortable experience with a bright, easygoing lift.

Leading the profile is limonene, the bright citrus terpene found in lemon and orange rinds, which may elevate the mood and add a cheerful, sunny quality.

Myrcene follows closely with a musky, earthy sweetness also found in ripe mangoes, hops, and lemongrass, and could bring a soothing, comfortable body feel that sets an unhurried pace.

ß-Caryophyllene adds a peppery spice also found in black pepper and cloves. As the only terpene known to interact directly with the body's CB2 receptors, it may lend a grounding, body-calming quality.

a-Humulene, the earthy terpene that gives hops their woody bite, may support a sense of physical comfort and is also purported to have appetite-suppressing effects.

A handful of supporting terpenes round out the profile. Terpineol lends a soft, lilac-like floral touch, while ß-pinene and a-pinene carry the crisp scent of pine needles and rosemary. Fenchol contributes a basil-like herbal note, and a-bisabolol, the gentle compound found in chamomile, may add a calming finish. Trace amounts of borneol (used for centuries in traditional Chinese medicine), camphene (also found in fir needles), caryophyllene oxide, and terpinolene (also found in lilac, nutmeg, and apples) add subtle depth to this mellow profile.

AK47 is celebrated for its balanced effects that inspire creativity and euphoria while keeping you relaxed and social—perfect for both daytime adventures and evening unwind. Expect a complex flavor profile blending earthy, spicy notes with hints of sweet florals and pungent fuel undertones. The infusion process enhances potency without compromising the strain's signature characteristics, making each puff smooth, flavorful, and satisfyingly strong.

321.desc: Lineage: Spritzer x Hellcat #15 Sour pez and grape sweet tarts fill the air with this variety. This Grown Rogue exclusive is hits deep, offers rich flavor, and an effect that delivers over and over.

322.desc: Military Chocolate is a potent, balanced 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain bred by Oni Seed Co (Bubba Kush x Tropicanna Cookies). It is known for its rich, dessert-like aroma of chocolate, coffee, and creamy vanilla. The high offers a fast-acting, euphoric, and creative buzz, accompanied by, relaxing body effects suitable for treating stress.

323.desc:
**Diamond Infused**

Magic Marker is a hybrid strain made from a genetic cross of Permanent Marker x RS-11 This strain is a stinker, with a pungent mix of astringent, minty chemical notes laced with sherbet sweetness and a tropical fruity twist—like sniffing your favorite marker during art class. Both of Magic Marker’s parent strains have won cup titles

324.desc: Lemon Runtz from Victory Natural Farms is a hybrid cannabis strain celebrated for its sweet, citrusy flavor with bright lemon zest and a subtle, savory finish. Grown organically in living soil, it delivers a balanced, euphoric yet relaxing high, making it perfect for a variety of occasions. Fans love how it combines the classic smoothness of Runtz genetics with juicy, uplifting citrus notes.

325.desc: A unique strain that brings together bold, earthy flavors with a touch of citrus zest. Known for its potent effects, this hybrid delivers an invigorating high that energizes the mind while relaxing the body. Its dense, resin-coated buds boast a striking appearance, making it a feast for the eyes as well as the senses. Your companion for a nice uplift.

326.desc: A great strain comes from great genetics, but it takes a skilled hand to build upon that foundation. Or, in this case, a team of skilled hands. Enter Cookies and Seed Junky Genetics, the same crew responsible for Jealousy and The Soap. With this collaboration at the helm, you know Pancakes is sure to embody the finest qualities of a strong lineage.

327.desc:
Yoshi from Pete’s Farmstand is best thought of as a bright, modern hybrid with a playful profile. Based on how Pete’s Farmstand menus and related strain descriptions are typically presented, it likely leans toward sweet, fruity, and candy-like notes rather than the heavy gas of a classic OG, with a flavor that feels more lively than earthy.

The experience is usually described as balanced at first, with a quick cerebral lift that can make things feel more upbeat, chatty, and visually sharp before easing into a gentler body calm. That makes it a strain many people associate with afternoon or early evening use, especially when they want something enjoyable without immediately getting knocked out.

If you like strains that feel modern, flavorful, and easy to enjoy, Yoshi fits that lane well. It sounds like one of Pete’s Farmstand’s more approachable options: less pine-and-diesel, more sweet smoke, smooth vibes, and a steady hybrid finish.

328.desc:
Gorilla Butter X Strawberries n' Cream

Strawilla is a balanced hybrid that delights the senses with a juicy fusion of ripe strawberries and creamy vanilla, creating a rich and inviting aroma. Its vibrant, resin-coated buds reflect the strain's full-flavored character and premium quality.

The effects provide a smooth blend of uplifting cerebral stimulation and soothing body relaxation, making Strawilla an ideal choice for those seeking both mental clarity and calm focus throughout the day or evening. This harmony of effects supports creativity, mood enhancement, and a gentle unwinding without heaviness.

329.desc:
DogWalkers | 95 Cookies | Indica | 1g

[orig: Chem Dawg I-95 x Girl Scout Cookies] is a potent, heavy-hitting indica strain with an equally powerful, especially pungent nose of sour gas.

Dogwalkers Infused Show Dog “STAY” Big Pre-Roll offers 1g of hybrid flower infused with best-in-show THCa diamonds in a single format. Conveniently packaged in an on-the-go tube, each Big Show Dog is crafted with strain-specific premium flower and THCa diamonds; never shake, stems or seeds. Dogwalkers donates a portion of proceeds from every product sold to deserving animal shelters across the country.

330.desc:
The flavor is a standout highlight: sweet cinnamon sugar cookie with nutty undertones, accented by peppery kush and spicy black pepper on the exhale. The aroma mirrors the taste, blending flowery kush, nutty cookies, and a sharp black pepper overtone that lingers pleasantly.

Effects settle in slowly, starting with a gentle calm that wraps around both mind and body, then building into a happy, carefree mental state paired with deep physical relaxation. You’ll feel lifted and creative while also settling into the couch, ready to relax without full sedation.

331.desc:
Rosin Tech Labs’ Strawberry Punch Hash Joint is a premium 1g infused pre-roll crafted with 0.8g of Banana Punch flower and 0.2g of Strawberry Fumez ice water hash for a smooth, terpene-rich smoking experience. This 80/20 blend combines quality flower with pure solventless ice water hash to deliver enhanced flavor and potency in every draw.

Expect bright strawberry sweetness layered with creamy, dessert-like notes and subtle earthy undertones for a rich, flavorful finish. The balanced infusion provides an uplifting cerebral buzz followed by comfortable body relaxation, making it a versatile choice for any session.

332.desc:
**Diamond Infused**

If you've been on the hunt for a well-balanced bud with a surprisingly bright tendency, look no further than Lemon Cherry Sherbet to deliver on everything that you need. This bud packs full-bodied effects that brighten yet subdue, filling you with vibrant energy yet calming anxiety and racing thoughts. You'll feel this energy hit you quickly, infusing your mind with a soaring sense of euphoria that has you feeling super happy and outgoing, ready to get chatting. As your mind lifts, your body will begin to settle down into a place of calm that allows you freedom from aches and pains without dampening your energy level in the slightest.

333.desc: Candy Fumes is a hybrid created from the indica-forward Zkittlez and the high-potency Sherbanger. Candy Fumes packs the same sweet and flavorful palette as Zkittlez while incorporating the benefits of Sherbanger's superior genetics. That means a strong terpene profile and THC levels that typically exceed both of its parent strains, winning fans as much for its craveable flavor profile as for its warm body high. Fruity and sweet on the nose, fans of Candy Fumes report a giddy front end and gentle comedown for easy relaxation and pain relief.

334.desc: Military Chocolate is a potent, balanced 50/50 hybrid cannabis strain bred by Oni Seed Co (Bubba Kush x Tropicanna Cookies). It is known for its rich, dessert-like aroma of chocolate, coffee, and creamy vanilla. The high offers a fast-acting, euphoric, and creative buzz, accompanied by, relaxing body effects suitable for treating stress.

336.desc:
TK Headband by Jerzy Landscapes delivers a bold and flavorful flower experience with bright citrus, earthy pine, and warm spice notes. Its classic terpene profile creates a smooth, well-rounded smoke with layers of character and a satisfying finish.

Tastes: Citrus zest, pine, warm spice, earthy herbs, and subtle sweetness

337.desc: Cheetah’s Galaxy Glue 5-Pack brings a bold, gassy aroma with sweet, earthy undertones. Each piece has a clean, colorful appearance, while the flavor blends funky fuel, sweet earth, and subtle hints of tropical fruit for a smooth, memorable finish.

338.desc: Frogurt (often stylized as Froyo) by The Cut is a hybrid cannabis strain known for its balanced effects and dessert-like flavor profile. It is a rare, exotic hybrid favored for its sweet and tangy taste, which is reminiscent of creamy frozen yogurt.

339.desc:
The strain functions as an aromatic collision between two of cannabis' most influential flavor families:

Mother Strain: Chemdawg #4 (or Chem4), which contributes heavy, fuel-soaked aromatics, chemical bite, and high potency.

Father Strain: Strawberry Sour Diesel (or a similar sweet berry variant depending on the breeder), which lends color, smoothness, and candy-like sweetness.

340.desc:
Mellowz inherits a unique "dessert-meets-fuel" profile:

Taste: Sweet, creamy marshmallow entry, quickly followed by grape candy and a citrus-sherbet zest on the exhale.

Aroma: A bright, sour lemon-citrus overtone layered over rich, burned-sugar sweetness and a faint diesel/jet-fuel depth.

341.desc: This iconic combination creates a super tasty child strain with soothing, nighttime effects that are perfect for getting you ready to get to sleep when you just can't seem to get there on your own. The flavor of Maple Root is a great nod to both of its parent strains, with a creamy and sugary root beer like taste accented by hints of fruity candies and a surprising punch of garlicky herbs. The aroma takes things up about five levels, adding in layers of pungent dank, skunky sage and woody pine to the fruity and sugary blend. The Maple Root high will begin immediately, starting with a tingle felt in the extremities that is numbing and pleasant. This tingle will soon begin to ebb and flow throughout the rest of your body, hitting your body with deep relaxation and your mind with a sense of hazy, happy sedation that leaves you feeling super elated yet unable to focus.

342.desc: FullTilt Labs Zabubu is a premium hybrid cannabis strain crafted from a potent cross of Zkittlez and Super Boof. This lineage explains the strain's complex combination of sugary, tropical fruit undertones and sharp citrus punch.

343.desc: Rolled up and ready to smoke, Pre-Rolls are a convenient and effective way to consume cannabis. Pre-Rolls come in many different forms and can be rolled with flower, shake, "b-buds", infused with concentrates, and more.

344.desc: Jerzy Landscapes presents TK Headband, a premium hybrid preroll delivering a balanced cannabis experience in a convenient 1g format. This expertly crafted preroll showcases the legendary Headband genetics, known for creating a distinctive pressure around the crown while melting away tension throughout the body. The hybrid classification offers the best of both worlds—uplifting cerebral effects paired with soothing physical relaxation. Expect earthy, piney aromas with subtle diesel undertones that translate into a smooth, flavorful smoke. Perfect for those seeking creative focus during the day or unwinding after work, TK Headband promotes feelings of euphoria and calm without overwhelming sedation. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or exploring quality flower prerolls, this 1g offering from Jerzy Landscapes delivers consistent potency and craftsmanship in every puff.

345.desc: Flash Point OG is a hybrid cannabis strain with a high THC content, known for its relaxing, euphoric, and calming effects. It is noted for its distinctive citrus, spicy, and floral aroma. The specific genetics for this strain are not widely publicized, but its lineage is different from that of other OG strains.

346.desc: Garlic & Bananas, a distinctive hybrid strain, is the result of crossing GMO and Banana Punch. Its effects encompass a calming sense of euphoria that may spark creativity. The strain’s unique aroma profile includes notes of sweet bananas and a touch of gas, creating an uplifting experience. With its combination of genetics, Garlic & Bananas offers a fusion of effects and aromas that may intrigue and uplift your senses.

347.desc:
Pink Ink is a hybrid from First Class Genetics that brings Permanent Marker and Spritzer genetics together. This strain delivers a colorful flavor experience—"pink" hard candy sweetness that blends with tangy Smarties notes, backed by gassy undertones and finished with floral perfume characteristics.

Effects might offer that creative balance between mental uplift and physical comfort. A lot of people appreciate how this one can work for social sessions or when they want something with personality, though everyone's ride is unique. The Permanent Marker genetics contribute that bold intensity, while Spritzer adds its own bubbly complexity to the mix.

This hybrid connects with those who dig vibrant flavors and versatile vibes. It's got that pop of color with some artistic edge—a strain that brings something bright and memorable for those looking to add some flair to their rotation.

348.desc: Bananaconda is a potent hybrid strain that delivers a striking aroma of sweet, ripe bananas combined with heavy diesel gas, earth, and spicy pine. Driven by dominant terpenes like Limonene and Myrcene, its effects begin with a fast-acting wave of heady euphoria and creative giggleness that effectively melts away mental stress. This initial cerebral lift gradually transitions into a warm, deeply relaxing body buzz that relieves physical tension, making it ideal for unwinding in the evening. While moderate doses keep you happily locked into creative projects, higher amounts lean heavily into its OG lineage, leading to deep couch-lock and sedation.

349.desc:
Dogwalkers l Spritzer Big Dog Pre Roll l 1pk l 1g

With a complex nose that is both sweet and fruity (think bubblegum) with a nice bit of funk and notes of grapefruit, this balanced hybrid flower has it all. Frosty and colorful, with a purple blush, Spritzer has the look, nose and potency that makes it one of a kind.

Dogwalkers “STAY” Big Dog pre-roll offers 1g of hybrid flower in a single format. Conveniently packaged in an on-the-go tube, each Big Dog is crafted with strain-specific premium flower; never shake, stems or seeds.

Dogwalkers donates a portion of proceeds from every product sold to deserving animal shelters across the country.

350.desc:

Mochi Melon is a sensory masterpiece born from elite Zkittlez genetics, blending the candy-coated intensity of Watermelon Zkittlez with the creamy, gassy depth of Mochi. This hybrid delivers a silky-smooth ride — fruity, floral, and slightly funky — with a euphoric lift and mellow physical ease. Expect vibrant buds kissed with trichomes and bursting with terpene-rich complexity.

LIMONENE (0.77%) – bright citrus zest, uplifting mood

Juicy melon and creamy berry on the inhale, finishing with floral notes, faint gas, and citrus zest. A layered flavor that unfolds with every puff.

351.desc: Planet of the Grapes x Lilac Diesel Planet of the Grapes × Lilac Diesel brings together rich grape sweetness and pungent diesel character for a bold, aromatic smoke with plenty of depth. Sweet dark fruit and grape notes meet sharp fuel, earthy spice, and subtle floral undertones, creating a complex profile that moves between fruity and gassy with every pull. The experience begins with an uplifting cerebral euphoria before settling into a relaxed, comfortable body feel, making this a flavorful and well-rounded pre-roll for both social sessions and winding down.

352.desc:
Salt Water Taffy — 2:1 THC:CBD

Smooth, mellow, and perfectly balanced, Salt Water Taffy from JERZY LANDSCAPES delivers a clean 2:1 experience that keeps your mind bright and your body at ease. This anytime hybrid offers a gentle lift wrapped in calm clarity, making it a great choice for newcomers and seasoned smokers looking for something easygoing and steady. It’s the kind of flower that lets you stay present, functional, and pleasantly floating—just like the name suggests.

353.desc: All Access by NICHE brings you an exceptional hybrid experience with Wavy (Zkilato x Runtz) crossed with Bebesita (Triangle Mintz x Mac). This pre roll showcases a complex genetic lineage that delivers the best of both worlds. Expect a balanced hybrid effect that uplifts the mind while relaxing the body, perfect for those seeking creative energy with a smooth, calming finish. The flavor profile is a rich blend of sweet, fruity notes with creamy undertones and hints of mint, creating a delightful sensory experience. Ideal for daytime creativity or evening relaxation, this premium flower offers versatility for any occasion. All Access by NICHE delivers quality craftsmanship in every jar, making this hybrid a standout choice for cannabis enthusiasts seeking sophisticated flavors and well-rounded effects.

354.desc: The 1:1 THC:CBD Restore Lotion is a balanced topical product that combines equal parts of THC and CBD to potentially soothe and revitalize the skin. This lotion aims to address skin concerns using the synergistic effects of THC's mild psychoactivity and CBD's calming properties. It contains natural ingredients for hydration and is meant for targeted application.

355.desc: Say hello to convenience with our high-CBD Escape Artists Relief Cream, now available in a gym bag-friendly tube! We’ve combined the restorative benefits of camphor and menthol with 1000mg total cannabinoids, making it perfect for your post-workout routine. This blend provides quick, targeted results where you need it most with 800mg CBD, 100mg CBG, and 100mg THC. This enhanced formula supports anyone from seasoned athletes to weekend warriors seeking relief that will leave your skin soft and revitalized.

356.desc: Doctor Solomon’s Rescue Lotion is a medical-grade, cannabis-infused transdermal topical designed to provide emergency, fast-acting relief for deep tissue inflammation, chronic flare-ups, and localized pain. Unlike standard over-the-counter topicals that only coat the surface, this formula utilizes a proprietary transdermal carrier that penetrates beneath the skin barrier to deliver cannabinoids directly to affected blood vessels and muscle tissues.

357.desc:
SUN X Megaleaf marks a first-of-its-kind collaboration: the first extracts made with Megaleaf flower in New Jersey.

Blue Z blends the dessert-like sweetness of The Original Z lineage with the rich depth of Blue Diamond, creating an indica-leaning cured resin vape with layered flavor and unmistakable terpene presence. Bright bursts of tart citrus and candied fruit open the profile before settling into creamy earth, soft wildflower notes, and smooth herbal spice on the finish. Dominant myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene give the vapor a dense aromatic character with sweet citrus lift, subtle floral complexity, and lingering candy-like smoothness throughout each pull.

Powered by a quartz atomizer for clean, terp-true vapor, this 0.5g all-in-one device offers concentrate-level potency in a sleek, ready-to-use format — crisp, cooling, and out-of-this-world smooth. Crafted from cured Megaleaf flower using cannabis-derived extraction, the formulation preserves the cultivar’s full-spectrum expression with 100% cannabis and nothing added.

Built around quality flower, careful extraction, and terpene-preserving formulation, Eclipse X Megaleaf Blue Z delivers a refined cured resin vape experience focused on flavor depth, cultivar authenticity, and dependable craftsmanship.

a frosty layer of white crystal trichomes and sticky resin. The strain's dense buds and prominent trichome coverage not only contribute to its visual appeal but also underscore its potential strength.

369.desc:
Lemon Drop invites you to savor the essence of a sun-soaked summer with every inhale. This premium cannabis-infused distillate vape cartridge captures the perfect balance of sour and sweet, reminiscent of a freshly picked ripe lemon. The invigorating aroma of sharp, juicy citrus mingles with delightful candy undertones, creating a tantalizing scent that awakens the senses and sets the stage for a memorable experience.

The flavor profile of Lemon Drop is a vibrant celebration of citrusy brilliance. Each puff delivers a burst of zesty lemon paired with the sugary sweetness of your favorite candies, creating a mouth-puckering sensation that is both refreshing and indulgent. Enhanced by its terpene trio—Limonene, Pinene, and Terpinene—this vape cartridge offers layers of complexity. Limonene provides a bright citrus zest that uplifts the palate, while Pinene adds a subtle piney undertone for depth. Terpinene contributes a floral and herbal nuance, ensuring a smooth and well-rounded flavor journey that delights with every draw.

Experience a surge of energized inspiration with Lemon Drop, perfect for moments when you seek a creative spark or a boost of positivity. The uplifting effects invigorate the mind, fostering a sense of motivation and enthusiasm that enhances productivity and creative pursuits. Whether you're diving into an artistic project, enjoying a lively conversation, or embracing a day of exploration, Lemon Drop delivers a vibrant and uplifting high that keeps you inspired and engaged. Let Lemon Drop elevate your mood and ignite your creativity, making every moment brighter.

Top Reported Effects: Energized, Inspired

Top Reported Flavors: Lemon, Candy, Citrus, Sweet, Floral

Primary Terpene Profile: Limonene, Pinene, Terpinene

371.desc: SIMPLY HERB brings you Hawaiian Diesel in a convenient 1g 510 thread cartridge, delivering the perfect blend of tropical escape and diesel-fueled energy. This sativa-dominant strain combines the uplifting genetics of Hawaiian and NYC Diesel, creating an experience that's both invigorating and mentally stimulating. Expect bold flavors of sweet pineapple and citrus with earthy, fuel-forward undertones that make every pull memorable. Hawaiian Diesel is known for sparking creativity, focus, and euphoria—ideal for daytime adventures or when you need an energetic boost. The 510 thread design ensures universal compatibility with most standard batteries, making it easy to enjoy on the go. SIMPLY HERB's commitment to quality means you're getting a clean, potent cartridge that captures the strain's authentic terpene profile and effects. Perfect for those seeking an uplifting, tropical experience with a punch of diesel power.

Sweet, tangy, and rich with dessert-inspired character, Cheech & Chong’s D.A.V.E. Key Lime Pie delivers a flavorful hybrid experience in a convenient 1g vape cartridge. Combining bright citrus notes with the creamy, earthy character associated with Key Lime Pie, this vape offers a distinctive balance of sweetness and classic cannabis flavor.

Key Lime Pie features a refreshing flavor profile of tangy lime, sweet citrus, creamy dessert notes, and earthy herbs, complemented by subtle spice. The experience opens with bright, zesty citrus before transitioning into smoother, richer undertones reminiscent of its namesake dessert. Its combination of sweet and tart characteristics creates an enjoyable profile for consumers who appreciate citrus-forward cannabis strains.

As a hybrid, Key Lime Pie may produce feelings of euphoria, happiness, mental ease, and physical relaxation. Its balanced yet potentially mellow character makes it an appealing choice for laid-back afternoons, casual social sessions, or relaxed evenings. Individual effects may vary depending on tolerance and consumption.

The 1g vape cartridge provides a convenient, portable alternative to traditional flower. Designed for use with a compatible vape battery, D.A.V.E. Key Lime Pie offers a simple way to enjoy a dessert-inspired hybrid without grinding, rolling, or combustion.

374.desc: Get ready to experience legendary vibes with the LEMON OG cartridge from CHEECH & CHONG. This 1g hybrid 510 thread vape delivers the perfect balance of calm, euphoria, and zen—ideal for unwinding without losing your edge. Each draw bursts with zesty citrus and bright lemon flavor that dances on your palate, making every session a flavorful escape. Whether you're kicking back after a long day or seeking balanced effects that keep you grounded yet uplifted, Lemon OG brings that classic cannabis experience in a convenient, portable format. Compatible with standard 510 thread batteries, this cartridge is as easy to use as it is enjoyable. CHEECH & CHONG's commitment to quality shines through in every puff, delivering smooth vapor and consistent potency from start to finish. Embrace the chill, savor the citrus, and let Lemon OG elevate your moment.

375.desc: The Strike Baked Apple 1g Disposable Vape by Green Lightning delivers a rich, dessert-like aroma of sweet, warm orchard fruit and earthy pastry with subtle notes of cinnamon spice, vanilla, and dough. Driven by an indica-dominant terpene profile high in limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene, its effects begin with an uplifting, happy head buzz that quickly transitions into a deeply relaxing, heavy body high. This potent vape is highly effective for easing anxiety and melting away stress, making it an excellent choice for a sedating evening wind-down or combating insomnia.

376.desc:
Embark on a sensory journey with Boardwalk Bliss. This exceptional blend combines the tantalizing flavors of Strawberry Cheesecake and Sherbert Cookies, delivering a delightful experience that harks back to carefree moments on the boardwalk.

Boardwalk Bliss offers a harmonious balance of euphoria and relaxation, perfect for unwinding after a long day or enhancing your adventures. The uplifting effects will leave you feeling blissful and carefree, while the calming undertones provide a soothing finish.

380.desc:
Lemon G X Dosidos

The Vision is a hybrid strain. It combines genetics from the classic Ohio Lemon G, famous for her strong lemon peel and Christmas wreath flavor, and the resinous, award-winning Do-Si-Dos. This strain was created as a testament to the vision of a brighter future through the propagation and cultivation of quality cannabis.

Cultivated in regenerative living soil and processed entirely in-house by Brookside Reserve, a single-source operation dedicated to solventless extraction. By controlling every step from genetics and cultivation the team preserves the plant’s full terpene expression and natural resin quality.

381.desc: Discover a cosmic journey with the Galactic Grape AIO by Mule Extracts. This 2G disposable vape invites you to float among the stars, delivering a euphoric high that ignites creativity and relaxation. Gas Nana is a indica cultivar known for its bold fuel-forward aroma, dense structure, and heavy resin production. The flowers are typically tight and chunky, featuring deep green buds with occasional purple undertones, bright orange pistils, and a thick coating of frosty, sticky trichomes that reflect its rich terpene content.

Aroma & Flavor
Gas Nana is commonly described as offering a powerful blend of pungent diesel and earthy gas layered with sweet banana and ripe fruit. Subtle notes of creamy sweetness and light herbal spice add depth, creating a profile that balances tropical dessert tones with sharp fuel intensity. The flavor follows through with a smooth combination of sweet banana, creamy fruit, and a lingering gassy, earthy finish on the exhale.

Experience
Consumers often report a calm, mood-elevating onset followed by a steady wave of full-body relaxation. The effects are typically described as soothing and body-forward, supporting mental ease and physical comfort while maintaining a relaxed, functional state. Individual experiences may vary.

Typical Characteristics
Type: Indica

Primary Notes: Banana, sweet fruit, diesel, creamy earth

Reported Experience: Relaxed, uplifted, balanced calm

510.desc:
Cherry Mellow from Cookies is an indica-dominant hybrid celebrated for its rich flavor and potent effects. This strain is a cross between the popular Runtz and Funky Charms, combining the best traits of both to offer an incredibly flavorful experience. The flavor is often described as a delightful cherry marshmallow with a subtle hint of gas, creating a smooth and tasty smoke that appeals to those who enjoy sweet and dessert-like profiles.

Cherry Mellow boasts a robust terpene profile with notes of cherries, creamy cheesecake icing, earthy undertones, and a touch of gas. This complex aroma and flavor combination makes it uniquely satisfying and memorable. The effects of Cherry Mellow are primarily calming and relaxing, delivering a soothing body high that promotes happiness and uplifted mood, ideal for stress relief, anxiety reduction, and pain management. Users also report feeling focused yet mellow, making it versatile for both casual use and relaxation. While it may lead to some dry eyes or dizziness in rare cases, the overall experience is smooth and enjoyable, making Cherry Mellow a standout strain within the Cookies lineup for those seeking sweet flavor with mellow effects.

511.desc:
Blueprint P90 (3.5g) is a premium, indica-dominant cannabis flower heavily nicknamed the "Gas Man" due to its remarkably pungent, room-filling aroma. It is highly regarded for its top-tier indoor cultivation quality, resinous and sticky buds, and deeply sedative, heavy-hitting effects.

Strain Overview & Lineage

Lineage: P90 is a powerhouse cross between Gorilla Glue #4 (GG4) x Gelato 41, bringing together elite genetics that offer deep chemical, earthy, and sweet dessert qualities.

Appearance: Dense, hard, medium-sized light green buds layered with vibrant hues of violet and blue, completely coated in a heavy white layer of shimmering, resinous trichomes.

Aroma, Flavor, and Terpene Profile

The strain is famous for a "nose-burning funk" that combines traditional gassy undertones with unique flavor complexities:

Scent: A powerful infusion of skunk, diesel fuel, hazelnut, and chemicals, with a subtle menthol finish.

Taste: A clean, heavy inhale of gassy, creamy earthiness balanced by faint, sweet floral undertones on the exhale.

Dominant Terpenes: Testing reveals a profile heavily dominated by Beta-Caryophyllene, followed by Limonene, Linalool, and Humulene .

Experience & Effects

The High: Expect an immediate full-body melt that dissolves physical tension, creates "heavy eyes," and brings on a deeply tranquil state of mind.

Best Used For: Unwinding after a long day, managing physical aches, easing severe insomnia, or any evening routine dedicated to deep relaxation.

512.desc:
Triple Lindy is a award-winning premium hybrid cannabis strain bred by Blueprint Cannabis Co. that achieved major acclaim by winning Best Overall and Most Potent at the 2022 Winter Zalympix competition. Named after the famous impossible dive from the movie Back to School, this cultivar is highly regarded in the dessert-gas category for its heavy-hitting potency and dense, frosty bag appeal.

Genetic Lineage & Profile

While some early industry sources listed its family tree as a mystery, it is widely recognized as a modern hybrid cross between Z (Zkittlez) and Gelato 41 (G41).

Type: Indica-dominant leaning hybridStructure: Dense calyx stacking, tight internodal spacing, and a heavy coating of trichomes making it visually striking.

Cultivation: Notoriously difficult and sensitive to grow, but highly rewarding for experienced cultivators.

Flavor and Aroma Profile

The strain features a complex, layered "dessert-gas" profile that combines sweet and deeply savory elements:

Aroma: A pungent mix of rubber, musk, tropical fruit, and sweet candy gas.

Flavor: Creamy, doughy sweetness upfront, blending into heavy diesel, cheese, and a peppery-citrus finish.

Dominant Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Limonene, Linalool, Humulene, and Pinene.

Experienced Effects

Triple Lindy delivers a potent "one-two-three punch" that satisfies both physical and cerebral preferences:

Cerebral Lift: An immediate euphoric rush that boosts mood and relieves mental stress.

Body High: A deeply relaxing, heavy physical sedation that spreads across the limbs without immediate couchlock, making it ideal for evening use

Its high concentrations of Beta-Myrcene and Linalool produce an initial burst of happy, uplifting energy that gently transitions into a deeply calm and relaxed body buzz. This balanced profile makes it highly effective for relieving stress, easing physical tension, and elevating overall mood without causing immediate heavy sedation.
